contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Advance a deterministic signed 32-bit xorshift state. First substitute 0x2545F491 when seed is zero. In signed 32-bit arithmetic apply x ^= x << 13, then x ^= x >>> 17, then x ^= x << 5. Return the signed 32-bit result; this is deterministic, not a fresh random sample.
contract.domain: Seed is an integer in the signed 32-bit range.
contract.outputRole: next signed 32-bit state, not a bucket or entropy sample
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
